title: DOCSIS/XRA: fix typos + cleanup.
description:
DOCSIS/XRA: fix typos in comments and displayed fields + some cleanup.
- Mac -> MAC, Mdd -> MDD, Id|id -> ID...
- Consistent comments (capitalization, spaces)
- Use correct terminology from DOCSIS specification (e.g. "Transaction ID" instead of "Tran-Id|Tran Id...", "Dynamic Service Change Acknowledge" instead of "Dynamic Service Change *Acknowledgement*")

No "functional" changes!
